descriptionPlain:
Join Civitta - an international company with 750+ colleagues across 20+ countries. We focus on management consulting, funding, and digital solutions. Originating from Central and Eastern Europe, we also deliver projects across Central Asia, the Middle East, and the United States.
 
Are you passionate about solving complex business challenges and driving impactful change? We are seeking an ambitious Intern to join our advisory team, where you will have the opportunity to work across diverse sectors and practices.
 
This position is open across all Civitta locations: Estonia, Latvia, Lithuania, Finland, Sweden, Denmark, Poland, Slovakia, Czechia, Ukraine, Hungary, Bulgaria, Romania, Moldova, Kosovo, Serbia, North Macedonia, Armenia, Georgia, Portugal, Uzbekistan, Croatia and United States of America.
